words.enDefinition: a surety or insurance bond covering obligations or risks related to insurance

examples.en: Our broker arranged the insurance bond that covers the warehouse against theft and fire.
examples.zh: 经纪人帮我们安排了承保仓库盗窃和火灾风险的「保险债券」。

examples.en: The bank will repay the insurance bond once the contractor finishes the bridge project.
examples.zh: 承包商完成大桥工程后，银行将兑付这笔「保险债券」。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to insurance

examples.en: After the merger, the group sold its insurance business to focus on retail banking.
examples.zh: 合并之后，集团出售了旗下「保险企业」，以便专注零售银行业务。

examples.en: My uncle has run a small insurance business in Guangzhou for twenty years.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在广州经营一家小型「保险企业」已经二十年了。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of insurance

examples.en: The agent earns an insurance commission of fifteen percent on every policy sold.
examples.zh: 代理人每卖出一份保单，就能拿到15%的「保险佣金」。

examples.en: Did you include the insurance commission when you calculated the total premium?
examples.zh: 你计算总保费时，把「保险佣金」算进去了吗？

words.enDefinition: loans related to inter-fund

examples.en: Treasury uses inter-fund loans to smooth cash gaps between our pension and building funds.
examples.zh: 资金部用「基金之间的贷款」来平滑养老基金与建筑基金之间的现金缺口。

examples.en: All inter-fund loans must be repaid within ninety days under the new policy.
examples.zh: 按照新政策，「基金之间的贷款」必须在九十天内偿还。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from intensive

examples.en: The province chose intensive investment in high-tech plants rather than sprawling land purchases.
examples.zh: 该省选择对高科技工厂进行「集约投资」，而不是大举购置土地。

examples.en: Intensive investment in automation cut our unit costs by a third within two years.
examples.zh: 对自动化进行「集约投资」后，两年内单位成本下降了三分之一。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of minimum held for sale or use

examples.en: We keep a minimum stock of spare parts so repairs never wait for new orders.
examples.zh: 我们备有「最低库存量」的零部件，维修就不用等采购了。

examples.en: The system alerts the buyer whenever inventory drops below the minimum stock level.
examples.zh: 库存一旦低于「最低库存量」，系统就会提醒采购员。

words.enDefinition: a market for mining

examples.en: Sydney's mining market rallied hard after copper prices jumped ten percent overnight.
examples.zh: 铜价一夜之间大涨一成，悉尼的「矿山股票市场」应声反弹。

examples.en: She follows the mining market closely because her fund holds several coal producers.
examples.zh: 她密切跟踪「矿山股票市场」，因为她的基金持有多家煤炭公司。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for insurance reserve

examples.en: The regulator requires every insurer to top up its insurance reserve fund each quarter.
examples.zh: 监管机构要求每家保险公司每个季度补充「保险准备基金」。

examples.en: Claims spiked after the typhoon, draining the insurance reserve fund faster than planned.
examples.zh: 台风过后理赔激增，「保险准备基金」的消耗快于预期。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for insured pension

examples.en: Employee contributions go into an insured pension fund managed by a major insurer.
examples.zh: 员工的缴款存入由大型保险公司管理的「已保险养老基金」。

examples.en: Because it is an insured pension fund, her benefits stay safe even if the employer fails.
examples.zh: 由于是「已保险养老基金」，即使雇主倒闭，她的养老金待遇也有保障。

words.enDefinition: a market for inter-bank

examples.en: Smaller banks borrow surplus funds overnight in the inter-bank market.
examples.zh: 小银行在「银行间存款市场」隔夜拆入多余资金。

examples.en: Tight liquidity pushed rates in the inter-bank market to a two-year high.
examples.zh: 流动性紧张推动「银行间存款市场」利率升至两年来的高位。

words.enDefinition: the inter-bank rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Our loan pricing is linked to the inter-bank rate plus a fixed margin.
examples.zh: 我们的贷款定价与「银行间利率」挂钩，另加固定利差。

examples.en: The inter-bank rate eased slightly after the central bank injected liquidity.
examples.zh: 央行注入流动性后，「银行间利率」小幅回落。

words.enDefinition: a market for inter-bank sterling

examples.en: The treasury desk borrows dollars cheaply and swaps them in the inter-bank sterling market.
examples.zh: 资金交易台低成本借入美元，再在「银行间英镑市场」做掉期。

examples.en: Quote me a one-week rate in the inter-bank sterling market, please.
examples.zh: 请给我报一个「银行间英镑市场」的一周期利率。

words.enDefinition: bond holdings between related companies

examples.en: The auditor asked us to disclose all inter-company bond holdings in the notes.
examples.zh: 审计师要求我们在财务附注中披露全部「公司间持有对方债券」。

examples.en: Inter-company bond holdings must be eliminated when the group consolidates its accounts.
examples.zh: 集团合并报表时，必须抵销「公司间持有对方债券」。

words.enDefinition: the inter-bank market bid rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Lenders quote the inter-bank market bid rate before accepting large deposits each morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨，银行在接收大额存款前会先报出「银行间存款利率」。

examples.en: Our floating deposits earn interest at the inter-bank market bid rate plus ten basis points.
examples.zh: 我们的浮动利率存款按「银行间存款利率」加10个基点计息。

collocations: calculate the inter-bank market bid rate
compare the inter-bank market bid rate
interpret the inter-bank market bid rate

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for corporate pension

examples.en: The company tops up the corporate pension fund whenever investment returns fall short.
examples.zh: 投资收益不足时，公司会向「公司退休基金」补足资金。

examples.en: She moved her corporate pension fund into a low-fee index option last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，她把「公司退休基金」转入了低费率的指数型选项。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from corporate

examples.en: The board approved a corporate investment of two hundred million in battery plants.
examples.zh: 董事会批准了两亿元的「公司投资」，用于建设电池工厂。

examples.en: Rising rates made management delay several corporate investment projects until autumn.
examples.zh: 利率上升促使管理层把几个「公司投资」项目推迟到秋季。

words.enDefinition: a debenture for mortgage bank

examples.en: They bought a mortgage bank debenture yielding six percent for the income sleeve.
examples.zh: 他们买入了一只收益率为6%的「抵押银行债券」，放进组合的收益部分。

examples.en: Interest on the mortgage bank debenture is paid every March and September.
examples.zh: 这只「抵押银行债券」的利息在每年三月和九月支付。

collocations: bank with the mortgage bank debenture
open an account at the mortgage bank debenture
deal with the mortgage bank debenture

words.enDefinition: capital associated with corporate

examples.en: New shares issued last month boosted corporate capital by fifteen percent.
examples.zh: 上月发行的新股使「公司资本」增加了15%。

examples.en: The court ruled that reducing corporate capital requires creditor approval first.
examples.zh: 法院裁定，减少「公司资本」必须先征得债权人同意。

words.enDefinition: an organisation that invests large pools of capital, such as a fund or insurer

examples.en: Most institutional investors demanded a discount before subscribing to the rights issue.
examples.zh: 多数「机构投资者」要求折价，才愿意认购这次的供股。

examples.en: An institutional investor bought the entire block of shares after the market closed.
examples.zh: 收盘之后，一家「机构投资者」买下了整批股份。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to money market

examples.en: The money market rate climbed as banks scrambled for cash before quarter-end.
examples.zh: 季末银行争抢资金，「货币市场利率」随之攀升。

examples.en: We price the floating deposit at the money market rate plus a small spread.
examples.zh: 我们的浮动存款按「货币市场利率」加上一点利差来定价。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to money market

examples.en: Treasury keeps idle cash in money market securities such as T-bills and commercial paper.
examples.zh: 资金部把闲置现金投在国库券、商业票据等「货币市场证券」上。

examples.en: Money market securities mature within a year, so they carry little price risk.
examples.zh: 「货币市场证券」一年内到期，因此价格风险很小。

words.enDefinition: a trust arrangement for closed-end investment

examples.en: Shares of the closed-end investment trust trade below the value of its portfolio.
examples.zh: 这只「封闭性投资基金」的份额交易价格低于其投资组合的资产价值。

examples.en: Unlike open funds, a closed-end investment trust cannot issue new shares on demand.
examples.zh: 与开放式基金不同，「封闭性投资基金」不能应投资者要求增发份额。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with closed-end investment

examples.en: The closed-end investment company raised fixed capital once and never issues new shares.
examples.zh: 这家「限额型投资公司」一次性募集了固定资本，此后不再增发股份。

examples.en: Investors sold their closed-end investment company shares at a deep discount last week.
examples.zh: 上周，投资者以大幅折价卖出了「限额型投资公司」的股份。

collocations: bank with the closed-end investment company

words.enDefinition: a closed mortgage bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The closed mortgage bond cannot be paid off early except through the sinking fund.
examples.zh: 这只「限额抵押债券」除通过偿债基金外，不得提前偿付。

examples.en: They issued a closed mortgage bond secured by the new office tower.
examples.zh: 他们发行了以新写字楼作抵押的「限额抵押债券」。

words.enDefinition: yield earned from moody's bond

examples.en: Traders tracked Moody's bond yield tables to gauge where credit spreads were heading.
examples.zh: 交易员紧盯「穆迪氏债券收益率」表，判断信用利差的走向。

examples.en: The Moody's bond yield tables showed A-rated paper yielding five point two percent.
examples.zh: 「穆迪氏债券收益率」表显示，A级债券的收益率为5.2%。

words.enDefinition: a commencement of risk used in professional practice

examples.en: The commencement of risk is the moment the cargo leaves the seller's warehouse.
examples.zh: 货物离开卖方仓库的那一刻，就是「风险的开始」。

examples.en: Underwriters confirmed the commencement of risk as midnight on the sailing date.
examples.zh: 承保人确认「风险的开始」时间为开航日的午夜。

words.enDefinition: a bank focused on cross-border investment finance

examples.en: An international investment bank is advising the ministry on the railway bond sale.
examples.zh: 一家「国际投资银行」正就铁路债券发行向该部委提供顾问服务。

examples.en: She joined an international investment bank in Hong Kong after finishing her MBA.
examples.zh: 完成MBA学业后，她加入了香港的一家「国际投资银行」。

collocations: bank with the international investment bank

words.enDefinition: capital associated with commercial

examples.en: Merchants in the port city pooled commercial capital to finance the spice trade.
examples.zh: 港口城市的商人汇集「商业资本」，为香料贸易提供资金。

examples.en: Commercial capital circulates quickly, moving from goods back into cash within weeks.
examples.zh: 「商业资本」周转很快，几周内就能从货物变回现金。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for medical benefits

examples.en: Union members vote on how the medical benefits fund should cover new treatments.
examples.zh: 工会成员投票决定「医疗保险基金」如何覆盖新疗法。

examples.en: Contributions to the medical benefits fund rose two percent from this January.
examples.zh: 自今年一月起，「医疗保险基金」的缴款上调了2%。

words.enDefinition: a market for international capital

examples.en: Emerging governments tap the international capital market whenever local funding dries up.
examples.zh: 一旦本地资金枯竭，新兴国家政府就会转向「国际资本市场」融资。

examples.en: Falling US rates revived borrowing in the international capital market this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，美国利率下行令「国际资本市场」的融资活动回暖。

words.enDefinition: an insurance policy covering commercial forgery risks

examples.en: The bank bought a commercial forgery policy after a clerk cashed fake cheques.
examples.zh: 一名职员兑付了假支票之后，银行购买了「商业伪造保险单」。

examples.en: Our commercial forgery policy covers altered drafts and counterfeit payment orders.
examples.zh: 我们的「商业伪造保险单」承保被篡改的汇票和伪造的付款指令。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to commercial credit

examples.en: Exporters use commercial credit insurance to stay safe when big buyers go bankrupt.
examples.zh: 出口商借助「商业信贷保险」来防范大买家破产的风险。

examples.en: The insurer cut coverage limits under our commercial credit insurance for energy buyers.
examples.zh: 保险公司下调了我们「商业信贷保险」中能源客户的承保限额。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to commercial paper

examples.en: The commercial paper rate jumped thirty basis points as issuers rushed to roll over debt.
examples.zh: 发行人纷纷展期债务，「商业票据利率」跳升了30个基点。

examples.en: Top-rated companies borrow at the commercial paper rate far below bank lending rates.
examples.zh: 顶级公司按「商业票据利率」借款，成本远低于银行贷款利率。

words.enDefinition: a debenture for interest-bearing bank

examples.en: The bank issued an interest-bearing bank debenture to rebuild its capital base.
examples.zh: 银行发行了一只「有息银行债券」，以充实资本实力。

examples.en: Coupons from the interest-bearing bank debenture arrive each January and July.
examples.zh: 「有息银行债券」的利息每年一月和七月到账。

words.enDefinition: the middle inter-bank rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Dealers settle cross-currency swaps at the middle inter-bank rate published at noon.
examples.zh: 交易员按午间公布的「银行同业中间利率」结算交叉货币掉期。

examples.en: The middle inter-bank rate sits between the best bid and the lowest offer.
examples.zh: 「银行同业中间利率」介于最优买入价与最低卖出价之间。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to middle priced

examples.en: Her portfolio blends blue chips with middle priced stock in consumer brands.
examples.zh: 她的组合里既有蓝筹股，也配置了消费品牌的「中间价格股票」。

examples.en: Fund managers rotated into middle priced stock after the small-cap rally faded.
examples.zh: 小盘股行情降温后，基金经理们转向了「中间价格股票」。

words.enDefinition: management of collateral

examples.en: Good collateral management let the desk reuse the same bonds across several trades.
examples.zh: 出色的「担保品管理」让交易台把同一批债券用在了多笔交易上。

examples.en: The new system automates collateral management, from valuation to substitution requests.
examples.zh: 新系统把「担保品管理」从估值到替换申请全流程自动化。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from intercorporate stock

examples.en: The parent's intercorporate stock investment in its supplier is shown at cost.
examples.zh: 母公司对其供应商的「公司间股份投资」按成本列示。

examples.en: Regulators capped intercorporate stock investment to stop circles of mutual shareholding.
examples.zh: 监管机构对「公司间股份投资」设了上限，以防出现相互持股的循环。

words.enDefinition: money received from non-interest

examples.en: Fees from wealth management now make up half of the bank's non-interest income.
examples.zh: 财富管理费如今占这家银行「非利息收入」的一半。

examples.en: Rate cuts squeezed lending margins, so the bank pushed non-interest income harder.
examples.zh: 降息压缩了贷款利差，银行因此更卖力地增加「非利息收入」。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to non-interest bearing

examples.en: The fund holds non-interest bearing securities such as discount notes maturing in May.
examples.zh: 该基金持有五月到期的贴现票据等「不附息证券」。

examples.en: Discount bonds are non-interest bearing securities sold below face and redeemed at par.
examples.zh: 折价发行、到期按面值兑付的贴现债券，属于「不附息证券」。

words.zhGloss: 未保险的抚恤(养老)基金
words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for non-insured pension
acceptedZhAnswers: 未保险的抚恤(养老)基金

examples.en: The subsidiary still runs a non-insured pension fund, so benefits depend on company performance.
examples.zh: 这家子公司仍采用「未保险的抚恤(养老)基金」，待遇高低取决于公司经营状况。

examples.en: Auditors flagged the non-insured pension fund because it has no external guarantee.
examples.zh: 审计师特别指出，「未保险的抚恤(养老)基金」缺乏外部担保。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for non-expendable

examples.en: Trust law treats the endowment as non-expendable funds; only the income may be spent.
examples.zh: 信托法把这笔捐赠视为「不得耗用的基金」，只能动用其收益。

examples.en: The museum's non-expendable funds stay untouched while entrance fees cover daily costs.
examples.zh: 博物馆的「不得耗用的基金」保持不动，日常开支靠门票收入支撑。

words.enDefinition: the nominal interest rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: A five percent nominal interest rate turned negative once inflation hit eight percent.
examples.zh: 通胀达到8%之后，5%的「名义利率」实际上变成了负数。

examples.en: The contract quotes a nominal interest rate, so read the fine print for fees.
examples.zh: 合同上写的是「名义利率」，所以要看清小字里的各项费用。

words.enDefinition: export activity related to no-draft

examples.en: The buyer pays by telegraphic transfer, so this shipment is a no-draft export.
examples.zh: 买家用电汇付款，所以这批货属于「无汇票出口」。

examples.en: No-draft export saves bank charges, but it leaves us carrying the credit risk.
examples.zh: 「无汇票出口」省下银行费用，但信用风险得由我们自己承担。

words.enDefinition: import activity related to no-draft

examples.en: We handle this machinery order as a no-draft import, paying simply by wire transfer.
examples.zh: 这笔机械订单按「无汇票进口」处理，直接用电汇付款。

examples.en: No-draft import terms suit trusted suppliers we have worked with for years.
examples.zh: 「无汇票进口」的条件适合合作多年的老供应商。

words.enDefinition: not involving commercial foreign exchange division

examples.en: Send tuition remittances to the non-commercial foreign exchange division, not to trade services.
examples.zh: 学费汇款请找「非贸易的外汇部门」，别找贸易服务部门。

examples.en: The non-commercial foreign exchange division handles scholarships, remittances, and other invisible payments.
examples.zh: 「非贸易的外汇部门」办理奖学金、汇款等非贸易性支付。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for non-business revolving

examples.en: The library runs on a non-business revolving fund that the university replenishes monthly.
examples.zh: 图书馆靠「非营业周转性基金」运转，大学每月为其补充资金。

examples.en: Any surplus in the non-business revolving fund returns to the university at year-end.
examples.zh: 「非营业周转性基金」如有盈余，年末要交回大学。

words.enDefinition: a bond registered in the owner’s name rather than payable to whoever holds the certificate (bearer)

examples.en: A non-bearer bond records the owner's name, so a stolen certificate alone is worthless.
examples.zh: 「记名债券」登记持有人姓名，单凭一张被窃的凭证是无法兑现的。

examples.en: Each non-bearer bond lists the holder, and coupons are mailed to the registered address.
examples.zh: 每张「记名债券」都登记持有人，息票会寄往登记地址。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from independent

examples.en: The two plants are an independent investment, since neither affects the other's cash flow.
examples.zh: 这两座工厂属于「独立投资」，彼此的现金流互不影响。

examples.en: In capital budgeting, an independent investment can be accepted without rejecting other projects.
examples.zh: 在资本预算中，采纳一项「独立投资」并不妨碍其他项目。

words.enDefinition: an incremental cost of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: The CFO rejected the expansion because the incremental cost of capital exceeded project returns.
examples.zh: 首席财务官否决了扩建计划，因为「资本的边际成本」高于项目回报。

examples.en: As debt piles up, the incremental cost of capital rises with each new loan.
examples.zh: 债务越滚越多，每新增一笔借款，「资本的边际成本」就更高。

words.enDefinition: the cost of investments

examples.en: We disclose the cost of investments in the notes, including brokerage fees paid.
examples.zh: 我们在附注中披露「投资成本」，其中包含已支付的经纪费用。

examples.en: Impairment tests compare fair value with the cost of investments each quarter.
examples.zh: 每季度做减值测试时，会把公允价值与「投资成本」进行比较。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from normal

examples.en: A little currency wobble is normal risk in exporting, not a reason to panic.
examples.zh: 出口业务中汇率有些波动属于「正常风险」，不必惊慌。

examples.en: The underwriter prices the policy to cover normal risk, not every imaginable disaster.
examples.zh: 承保人的定价只覆盖「正常风险」，并非一切能想到的灾难。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for index of stock

examples.en: The index of stock price climbed two percent after the inflation report.
examples.zh: 通胀数据公布后，「股票价格指数」上涨了2%。

examples.en: Analysts compare the index of stock price with earnings growth to spot bubbles.
examples.zh: 分析师把「股票价格指数」与盈利增速对比，用来发现泡沫。

collocations: calculate the index of stock price
compare the index of stock price
reduce the index of stock price

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from initial

examples.en: The project pays back its initial investment of four million within three years.
examples.zh: 该项目能在三年内收回四百万元的「期初投资」。

examples.en: Management underestimated the initial investment, and cash ran out before launch.
examples.zh: 管理层低估了「期初投资」，资金在产品上市前就耗尽了。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from initial capital

examples.en: Her initial capital investment in the bakery was only sixty thousand yuan.
examples.zh: 她开办面包店时的「创办资本投资」只有六万元。

examples.en: The initial capital investment covered ovens, signage, and three months of rent.
examples.zh: 这笔「创办资本投资」涵盖了烤箱、招牌和三个月的房租。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from natural

examples.en: Farmers accept natural risk from droughts and floods as part of growing crops.
examples.zh: 旱涝灾害这类「正常的风险」，本就是务农绕不开的一部分。

examples.en: Insurers pool natural risk across regions so one typhoon cannot wipe them out.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「正常的风险」在各地分散承保，免得一场台风就血本无归。

words.enDefinition: a bank chartered at the national level

examples.en: Federal examiners inspect every national bank in the district twice a year.
examples.zh: 联邦检查员每年对辖区内的每家「国民银行」检查两次。

examples.en: She opened her first business account at a national bank downtown.
examples.zh: 她的第一个企业账户是在市中心的「国民银行」开立的。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for multiple investment sinking

examples.en: The city funds its sewer bonds through a multiple investment sinking fund.
examples.zh: 该市通过「多种投资偿债基金」为排污债券筹措偿还资金。

examples.en: A multiple investment sinking fund can hold Treasuries, CDs, and short-term notes.
examples.zh: 「多种投资偿债基金」可以持有国债、存单和短期票据。

collocations: arrange the multiple investment sinking fund
monitor the multiple investment sinking fund
repay the multiple investment sinking fund

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to corporation

examples.en: Her estate consists mainly of corporation securities in listed manufacturers and utilities.
examples.zh: 她的遗产主要是几家上市制造企业和公用事业公司的「公司有价证券」。

examples.en: Transfers of corporation securities must be recorded in the share register.
examples.zh: 「公司有价证券」的转让必须登记在股东名册上。

words.zhGloss: 公司股票；公司股本证券
words.enDefinition: shares or equity securities issued by a corporation
acceptedZhAnswers: 公司股票；公司股本证券

examples.en: The charter authorizes ten million shares of corporation stock for issuance.
examples.zh: 公司章程授权发行一千万股「公司股票」。

examples.en: Holders of corporation stock vote on major mergers at the annual meeting.
examples.zh: 「公司股票」的持有人可以在年会上就重大并购进行表决。

words.enDefinition: investments held or made in relation to mutual fund

examples.en: Her retirement savings sit mostly in mutual fund investments tracking broad indexes.
examples.zh: 她的退休储蓄大多放在跟踪大盘指数的「共有基金投资」上。

examples.en: Mutual fund investments let small savers own a slice of hundreds of stocks.
examples.zh: 借助「共有基金投资」，小额储户也能持有数百只股票中的一小份。

words.enDefinition: a municipal bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: Interest on the municipal bond is exempt from federal income tax.
examples.zh: 这只「市政债券」的利息免缴联邦所得税。

examples.en: The city issued a municipal bond to rebuild the flood-damaged waterfront.
examples.zh: 该市发行「市政债券」，为重建被洪水损毁的滨水区筹资。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with net working

examples.en: Suppliers stretching payment terms instantly improved our net working capital position.
examples.zh: 供应商放宽付款期限，立刻改善了我们的「净营运资本」状况。

examples.en: The lender checks net working capital before approving any seasonal credit line.
examples.zh: 银行在批准季节性授信之前，会先查看「净营运资本」。

words.zhGloss: 净运用(营运)资本周转率
words.enDefinition: turnover arising from net working capital
acceptedZhAnswers: 净运用(营运)资本周转率

examples.en: Our net working capital turnover improved to six times after inventory was trimmed.
examples.zh: 削减存货后，我们的「净营运资本周转率」提高到了6次。

examples.en: A falling net working capital turnover often signals cash trapped in stock.
examples.zh: 「净营运资本周转率」下降，往往说明现金被压在了库存里。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from net

examples.en: Gross spending was eight million, but net investment was only five after disposals.
examples.zh: 总支出八百万元，扣除资产处置后，「净投资额」只有五百万元。

examples.en: Negative net investment means the economy is wearing out capital faster than it replaces it.
examples.zh: 「净投资额」为负，说明经济的资本损耗快于更新。

words.enDefinition: a industrial revenue bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The county sold an industrial revenue bond to help the automaker build its plant.
examples.zh: 该县发行「工业收益债券」，帮助这家汽车厂商建厂。

examples.en: Repayments on the industrial revenue bond come from the factory's lease payments.
examples.zh: 「工业收益债券」的偿付来源是工厂的租金支付。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with circulating

examples.en: The grocer keeps circulating capital moving through stock that sells within days.
examples.zh: 这家杂货店的「周转资金」在几天内即可售出的存货中快速流转。

examples.en: Without enough circulating capital, even profitable firms can miss payroll on Friday.
examples.zh: 「周转资金」不足时，连盈利的公司也可能在周五发不出工资。

words.enDefinition: an unusual presentation where debt is shown as a negative amount

examples.en: The ledger shows negative debt because the supplier overpaid our account last week.
examples.zh: 供应商上周多付了款项，账上出现了「负债务」。

examples.en: A negative debt balance usually means a credit balance hiding in a liability account.
examples.zh: 「负债务」余额通常意味着负债账户里藏着一笔贷方余额。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from negative

examples.en: Factories scrapped more equipment than they bought, so the year showed negative investment.
examples.zh: 工厂报废的设备多于新购设备，全年表现为「负投资」。

examples.en: Negative investment signals that the economy is shrinking its capital stock.
examples.zh: 「负投资」表明经济正在收缩其资本存量。

words.enDefinition: a cost and insurance used in professional practice

examples.en: The quote is on a cost and insurance basis, excluding freight to your port.
examples.zh: 这份报价按「成本加保险费在内价」计算，不含运抵贵方港口的运费。

examples.en: Under cost and insurance terms, we arrange the marine policy ourselves.
examples.zh: 按「成本加保险费在内价」条件，海运保险由我们自行安排。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with net

examples.en: Brokers must keep net capital above twenty percent of aggregate indebtedness.
examples.zh: 经纪商必须保持「资本净额」高于总负债的20%。

examples.en: After the trading losses, the firm's net capital fell below the warning level.
examples.zh: 交易亏损之后，该公司的「资本净额」跌破了警戒线。

words.enDefinition: bonded debt after deducting related offsets

examples.en: Analysts subtract cash reserves to compute the county's net bonded debt.
examples.zh: 分析师扣减现金储备后，计算出该县的「债券负债净额」。

examples.en: Toll revenues let the city retire bonds early, cutting its net bonded debt.
examples.zh: 收费公路收入让该市提前赎回债券，压低了「债券负债净额」。

words.enDefinition: the bank that negotiates documents under a letter of credit

examples.en: The negotiating bank checks the documents before paying the exporter under the letter of credit.
examples.zh: 在信用证项下，「议付银行」审核单据后才会向出口商付款。

examples.en: Our negotiating bank advanced funds against the shipment documents the same day.
examples.zh: 「议付银行」当天就凭货运单据向我们垫付了款项。

collocations: open an account at the negotiating bank

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to liability

examples.en: Cash was tight, so the board declared a liability dividend payable in notes.
examples.zh: 现金紧张，董事会宣布以应付票据形式发放「负债股利」。

examples.en: A liability dividend creates a debt that converts to equity once cash returns.
examples.zh: 「负债股利」先形成一笔债务，待现金充裕后再转为股本。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates liabilities to capital

examples.en: The bank reviews our liabilities to capital ratio before renewing the credit line.
examples.zh: 银行在续批授信额度之前，会审查我们的「负债对资本比率」。

examples.en: A liabilities to capital ratio above three alarmed the credit committee.
examples.zh: 「负债对资本比率」超过3倍，令信贷委员会高度警惕。

collocations: calculate the liabilities to capital ratio
compare the liabilities to capital ratio
interpret the liabilities to capital ratio

words.enDefinition: the contracted interest rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: The contracted interest rate stays fixed at six percent for five years.
examples.zh: 「合同规定利率」在五年内固定为6%。

examples.en: Late payments trigger a penalty above the contracted interest rate.
examples.zh: 逾期付款将按高于「合同规定利率」的标准计收罚息。

words.enDefinition: a legal rate of interest used in professional practice

examples.en: Courts award judgment debts at the legal rate of interest set by statute.
examples.zh: 法院对判决债务按法规设定的「法定利率」计息。

examples.en: Charging more than the legal rate of interest makes the loan clause unenforceable.
examples.zh: 收息一旦超过「法定利率」，该贷款条款便不受法律保护。

collocations: calculate the legal rate of interest
compare the legal rate of interest
interpret the legal rate of interest

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from legal

examples.en: Trustees may only buy assets on the legal investment list, mostly government bonds.
examples.zh: 受托人只能购买「合法投资」清单上的资产，主要是国债。

examples.en: Savings banks stick to legal investment rules when they buy corporate bonds.
examples.zh: 储蓄银行购买公司债券时，必须遵守「合法投资」的相关规定。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the legal type

examples.en: Pension trustees may hold legal bonds without breaching their fiduciary duty.
examples.zh: 养老金受托人持有「法定债券」并不违反其信义义务。

examples.en: Only legal bonds qualify for the trust's conservative fixed-income allocation.
examples.zh: 只有「法定债券」才符合该信托保守的固定收益配置要求。

words.enDefinition: a bank that extends a loan

examples.en: The lending bank released the second tranche after inspecting the building site.
examples.zh: 「贷款银行」在查看工地之后发放了第二笔贷款。

examples.en: Our lending bank required insurance on the machinery before releasing funds.
examples.zh: 「贷款银行」要求先为设备投保，然后才予放款。

collocations: open an account at the lending bank

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to contractual

examples.en: The trust deed spells out a contractual dividend of six percent on the preference shares.
examples.zh: 信托契约明确约定，优先股享有6%的「合同(契约)规定股利」。

examples.en: Even in a loss year, the contractual dividend on these shares must be paid.
examples.zh: 即便在亏损年度，这类股份的「合同(契约)规定股利」也必须照付。

words.enDefinition: the bank that adds its confirmation to a letter of credit

examples.en: Exporters feel safer once a confirming bank adds its guarantee to the letter of credit.
examples.zh: 一旦「保兑银行」为信用证加具保兑，出口商就踏实多了。

examples.en: Our confirming bank charges a small fee to guarantee the opening bank's payment.
examples.zh: 我们的「保兑银行」收取少量费用，为开证行的付款提供担保。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to contract of marine

examples.en: The contract of marine insurance covers the cargo from Shanghai to Rotterdam.
examples.zh: 这份「海洋保险合同」承保从上海到鹿特丹的货物。

examples.en: Any deviation from the agreed route can void the contract of marine insurance.
examples.zh: 船舶一旦偏离约定航线，「海洋保险合同」可能因此失效。

words.enDefinition: contribution margin divided by sales

examples.en: Our contribution margin ratio hit forty percent after we raised prices in May.
examples.zh: 五月提价后，我们的「边际贡献率」达到了40%。

examples.en: Even a small rise in the contribution margin ratio lifts profits sharply.
examples.zh: 「边际贡献率」哪怕小幅上升，利润也会明显增加。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to listed

examples.en: Mutual funds prefer listed securities because daily prices make valuation easy.
examples.zh: 共同基金偏爱「上市证券」，因为每日都有报价，估值很方便。

examples.en: The company's listed securities fell ten percent on the first day of trading.
examples.zh: 该公司「上市证券」在上市首日下跌了10%。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to listed

examples.en: Only listed stock may be purchased on margin under our house rules.
examples.zh: 按照公司规定，只有「挂牌股票」才能融资买入。

examples.en: He prefers listed stock because quotes are published every few seconds.
examples.zh: 他偏爱「挂牌股票」，因为行情每隔几秒就会更新。

words.enDefinition: security pledged for loan on

examples.en: The broker extends a loan on collateral of client securities held in custody.
examples.zh: 经纪商以托管中的客户证券作担保，发放「证券担保贷款」。

examples.en: If the collateral falls in value, the loan on collateral faces a margin call.
examples.zh: 担保品一旦跌价，这笔「证券担保贷款」就会面临追加保证金。

words.enDefinition: a loan secured by bills of exchange

examples.en: The importer arranged a loan on bills to pay the supplier before resale.
examples.zh: 进口商办理「票据抵押贷款」，在转售之前先把货款付给供应商。

examples.en: A loan on bills against accepted drafts keeps the exporter's cash flowing.
examples.zh: 以已承兑汇票作押的「票据抵押贷款」，让出口商的现金流不断。

words.enDefinition: capital raised by borrowing rather than by issuing equity

examples.en: The expansion was financed with loan capital rather than new equity.
examples.zh: 这次扩建用「借入资本」融资，而不是发行新股。

examples.en: Rising rates raised the cost of loan capital across the whole sector.
examples.zh: 利率上升推高了整个行业的「借贷资本」成本。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from loan for financial

examples.en: The trust secured a loan for financial investment to purchase the bond portfolio.
examples.zh: 该信托取得「财务投资贷款」，用于购入债券组合。

examples.en: Interest on a loan for financial investment is deductible only against investment income.
examples.zh: 「财务投资贷款」的利息，只能在投资收益范围内抵扣。

collocations: arrange the loan for financial investment
monitor the loan for financial investment
repay the loan for financial investment

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to loaning

examples.en: Our loaning rate for small traders is two points above the deposit rate.
examples.zh: 我们对小商贩的「贷款利率」比存款利率高出两个点。

examples.en: Country banks cut their loaning rate to win customers from the city banks.
examples.zh: 乡镇银行下调「贷款利率」，从城市银行手里抢客户。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to loan

examples.en: The loan rate on car finance rose again this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，汽车贷款的「贷款利率」又上调了。

examples.en: Negotiate the loan rate before you sign; banks sometimes match rivals.
examples.zh: 签约前先谈妥「贷款利率」，银行有时会跟进对手的报价。

words.enDefinition: a loan teller used in professional practice

examples.en: The loan teller walked me through the documents for the car loan.
examples.zh: 「贷款员」带我逐项过完了车贷需要的文件。

examples.en: Ask the loan teller how the monthly payment changes with a shorter term.
examples.zh: 不妨问问「贷款员」，缩短贷款期限后月供会有什么变化。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning loan secured by

examples.en: The cooperative grants a loan secured by credit to members with two clean seasons.
examples.zh: 合作社向连续两季无违约的社员发放「以信用担保贷款」。

examples.en: A loan secured by credit carries higher rates because there is no collateral.
examples.zh: 「以信用担保贷款」没有抵押物，利率自然更高。

collocations: arrange the loan secured by credit
monitor the loan secured by credit
repay the loan secured by credit

words.enDefinition: security pledged for loan against

examples.en: He took a loan against collateral of his shop deed to pay tuition.
examples.zh: 他以商铺房契作抵办理「抵押贷款」，用来支付学费。

examples.en: The lender appraised the warehouse before granting the loan against collateral.
examples.zh: 放贷机构在发放「抵押贷款」前，先对仓库做了评估。

words.enDefinition: an isolation of risk used in professional practice

examples.en: Holding each project in a separate company achieves isolation of risk.
examples.zh: 把每个项目放进单独的公司，就实现了「风险隔离」。

examples.en: Bankers praised the isolation of risk built into the holding company structure.
examples.zh: 银行家们很赞赏这种控股结构带来的「风险隔离」效果。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in limited dividend

examples.en: The housing association is a limited dividend corporation capped at eight percent payouts.
examples.zh: 这家住房协会是「有限股利公司」，分红上限为8%。

examples.en: Investors accept lower returns because the limited dividend corporation serves a social mission.
examples.zh: 「有限股利公司」承担社会使命，投资者因此接受较低的回报。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in issuance transactions

examples.en: The issuance price was set ten percent below last week's market close.
examples.zh: 「发行价格」定在上周收盘价折让10%的水平。

examples.en: Small investors subscribed at the issuance price with no brokerage charge.
examples.zh: 散户按「发行价格」认购，无需支付经纪佣金。

words.enDefinition: to sell newly issued securities through competitive bids from investors

examples.en: The central bank plans to issue by tender new bills next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 央行将在下周二「以投标发行证券」，品种是新一期国库券。

examples.en: Smaller treasuries also issue by tender to discover a fair market price.
examples.zh: 规模较小的财政部门同样「以投标发行证券」，以此发现公平的市价。

collocations: issue by tender a series of bills

words.enDefinition: a market for issue

examples.en: Frothy demand in the issue market let the bank price its shares high.
examples.zh: 「发行市场」需求火热，银行得以把股票定价定得很高。

examples.en: Weak sentiment shut the issue market for junk-rated issuers this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度市场情绪低迷，垃圾级发行人在「发行市场」上几乎发不出债。

words.enDefinition: investments held or made in relation to liquid

examples.en: The clinic parks spare cash in liquid investments it can sell any day.
examples.zh: 诊所把闲钱放进随时可以卖出的「短期投资」里。

examples.en: Treasury bills and similar liquid investments keep the endowment ready for urgent grants.
examples.zh: 国库券等「短期投资」让基金会随时有钱应对紧急资助。

words.enDefinition: a trust arrangement for contractual type investment

examples.en: In a contractual type investment trust, investors sign an agreement rather than buy shares.
examples.zh: 在「合同(契约)式投资信托」中，投资者签订信托合同，而不是购买股份。

examples.en: The contractual type investment trust pays income according to the signed agreement.
examples.zh: 「合同(契约)式投资信托」按照签订的合同支付收益。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from contractual

examples.en: The pension's contractual investment commitments lock it in for ten years.
examples.zh: 这只养老金的「合同(契约)性投资」承诺一签就是十年。

examples.en: Insurance firms hold contractual investment assets to match guaranteed policy payouts.
examples.zh: 保险公司持有「合同(契约)性投资」资产，以匹配保单的保证给付。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the junior type

examples.en: Junior bonds rank behind senior notes if the issuer goes bankrupt.
examples.zh: 一旦发行人破产，「低级债券」的清偿顺序排在优先票据之后。

examples.en: The fund buys junior bonds to boost yield, fully aware of the extra risk.
examples.zh: 基金清楚风险更高，仍买入「低级债券」以提高收益。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to junior

examples.en: In liquidation, junior securities recover little after the secured lenders are paid.
examples.zh: 清算时先偿付有担保债权人，「低级证券」能收回的所剩无几。

examples.en: Traders demand fatter coupons on junior securities before touching them.
examples.zh: 交易员要求「低级证券」给出更厚的票息才肯接手。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for contingency

examples.en: The school board keeps a contingency fund for emergency roof repairs.
examples.zh: 学校董事会留有一笔「意外损失基金」，用于屋顶的应急维修。

examples.en: The hurricane exhausted the utility's contingency fund in just two months.
examples.zh: 飓风在两个月内就耗尽了公用事业公司的「意外损失基金」。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning consumer

examples.en: Easy consumer credit fueled a boom in furniture and appliance sales.
examples.zh: 宽松的「消费者信贷」推动了家具和家电的销售热潮。

examples.en: The regulator caps consumer credit rates to protect young borrowers.
examples.zh: 监管机构为保护年轻借款人，对「消费者信贷」利率设定了上限。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with consumer finance

examples.en: The consumer finance company lends to shoppers the big banks turn away.
examples.zh: 大银行不愿接的客户，由「消费者信贷(金融)公司」来放款。

examples.en: She works at a consumer finance company handling installment plans for appliances.
examples.zh: 她在一家「消费者信贷(金融)公司」工作，负责家电分期业务。

collocations: bank with the consumer finance company

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with consumer loan

examples.en: A consumer loan company approved her tuition loan within two days.
examples.zh: 一家「消费贷款公司」在两天内就批准了她的学费贷款。

examples.en: A consumer loan company charges more, but it moves fast when cash is urgent.
examples.zh: 「消费贷款公司」收费更高，但急需用钱时放款很快。

collocations: open an account at the consumer loan company
deal with the consumer loan company

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to consumer credit

examples.en: Lenders buy consumer credit insurance to cover defaults on personal loans.
examples.zh: 放贷机构购买「消费者信贷保险」，为个人贷款的违约风险兜底。

examples.en: Her job loss triggered a claim under the consumer credit insurance policy.
examples.zh: 她失业之后，「消费者信贷保险」保单随即启动了理赔。

words.enDefinition: a market for kerb

examples.en: Unapproved shares changed hands in the kerb market outside official trading hours.
examples.zh: 未获批准上市的股份在交易时段之外，于「场外交易市场」转手。

examples.en: The kerb market got its name from trading on London's pavements.
examples.zh: 「场外交易市场」这个名字，源于当年在伦敦人行道上的交易。

collocations: clear goods through the kerb market

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from consumer's

examples.en: Our sampling plan keeps consumer's risk below five percent per shipment.
examples.zh: 我们的抽检方案把「消费者的风险」控制在每批5%以内。

examples.en: A tighter acceptance standard lowers consumer's risk but raises inspection costs.
examples.zh: 收货标准越严，「消费者的风险」越低，但检验成本也随之上升。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to consignment sale export

examples.en: The exporter covered unpaid consignment goods with consignment sale export insurance.
examples.zh: 出口商为尚未收款的寄销货物投保了「寄销出口保险」。

examples.en: Consignments to Southeast Asian agents are protected by consignment sale export insurance.
examples.zh: 发往东南亚代理商的寄销货物，均由「寄销出口保险」保障。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to leasehold interest

examples.en: The restaurant insured its renovations with a leasehold interest insurance policy.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅为装修投入购买了「租赁权益保险」。

examples.en: If the lease is terminated early, leasehold interest insurance compensates the lost value.
examples.zh: 租约一旦提前终止，「租赁权益保险」会补偿损失的装修价值。

words.enDefinition: a bank that finances land or agricultural property

examples.en: Farmers in the valley borrow seasonally from the state land bank.
examples.zh: 山谷里的农户按季节向州的「地产银行」借款。

examples.en: The land bank lends against farmland, keeping family farms alive in droughts.
examples.zh: 「地产银行」以农田作押放贷，帮家庭农场熬过旱灾。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for consolidated sinking

examples.en: The city merged its bond accounts into one consolidated sinking fund.
examples.zh: 该市把各个债券账户并入了同一个「统一(合并)偿债基金」。

examples.en: A consolidated sinking fund lets managers sweep idle balances toward redemptions.
examples.zh: 有了「统一(合并)偿债基金」，管理者可以把闲置资金统一用于债券赎回。

words.enDefinition: a project for large-scale capital investment

examples.en: The smelter, a large-scale capital investment project, anchors the region's economy.
examples.zh: 这座冶炼厂是一项「大规模投资项目」，支撑着整个区域的经济。

examples.en: Financing for the large-scale capital investment project came from three state banks.
examples.zh: 这项「大规模投资项目」的资金来自三家国有银行。

words.enDefinition: a manufacturer's output floater used in professional practice

examples.en: The factory insured all finished goods under a manufacturer's output floater.
examples.zh: 工厂用「制造商产量浮动保单」为全部成品投保。

examples.en: As production moved between warehouses, the manufacturer's output floater adjusted automatically.
examples.zh: 产量在各个仓库之间流转时，「制造商产量浮动保单」的保额自动调整。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to manufacturer's liability

examples.en: Retailers now demand proof of manufacturer's liability insurance from every supplier.
examples.zh: 如今零售商要求每个供应商都出示「制造厂商责任保险」的证明。

examples.en: The recall was covered because the maker carried manufacturer's liability insurance.
examples.zh: 厂商投保了「制造厂商责任保险」，召回损失因此获得了赔付。

words.enDefinition: a marginal cost of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: Beyond eighty percent debt, the marginal cost of capital climbs steeply.
examples.zh: 负债率一旦超过80%，「资本的边际成本」就会急剧攀升。

examples.en: We rank projects against the marginal cost of capital, not last year's average.
examples.zh: 项目排序的依据是「资本的边际成本」，而不是去年的平均水平。

collocations: model the marginal cost of capital
stress-test the marginal cost of capital
hedge the marginal cost of capital

words.enDefinition: a marginal productivity of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: Economists measure the marginal productivity of capital to explain why factories expand.
examples.zh: 经济学家用「资本的边际生产率」来解释工厂为何扩张。

examples.en: When the marginal productivity of capital falls below the interest rate, investment stalls.
examples.zh: 「资本的边际生产率」一旦低于利率，投资就会停滞。

collocations: calculate the marginal productivity of capital
compare the marginal productivity of capital
reduce the marginal productivity of capital

words.enDefinition: finance related to management through

examples.en: Good management through finance means steering projects by their cash forecasts.
examples.zh: 高明的「财务管理」，就是依据现金流预测来把控项目。

examples.en: The course teaches management through finance, from budgeting to dividend policy.
examples.zh: 这门课讲授「财务管理」，从预算编制一直讲到股利政策。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to commission

examples.en: The agency protects its income with commission insurance against early policy cancellations.
examples.zh: 代理公司投保「佣金保险」，以防保单提前解约造成收入损失。

examples.en: Commission insurance reimbursed the agent when the buyer withdrew within the cooling-off period.
examples.zh: 买家在犹豫期内撤单，「佣金保险」赔付了代理人的佣金损失。

words.enDefinition: a document conveying a production payment interest to another party

examples.en: The oil field changed hands along with a conveyance of production payment to the lender.
examples.zh: 油田易手时，连同一份转让给贷款方的「产品支付转让书」一并交割。

examples.en: Lawyers drafted the conveyance of production payment before the deal could close.
examples.zh: 交易成交之前，律师先拟好了「产品支付转让书」。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning marine insurance

examples.en: Before the ship sails, we sign a marine insurance contract for the cargo.
examples.zh: 开船之前，我们会为货物签订「海上保险合同」。

examples.en: The marine insurance contract covers storms, piracy, and general average contributions.
examples.zh: 这份「海上保险合同」承保风暴、海盗及共同海损分摊。

words.enDefinition: a bank that intervenes in a payment or documentary chain

examples.en: The payment passed through an intervening bank in Frankfurt before reaching Cairo.
examples.zh: 汇款经由法兰克福的一家「中间银行」中转，才抵达开罗。

examples.en: Charges from the intervening bank reduced the amount the supplier received.
examples.zh: 「中间银行」收取的费用，减少了供应商实际收到的金额。

collocations: open an account at the intervening bank

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to marketable

examples.en: The treasury parks spare cash in marketable securities that sell within a day.
examples.zh: 资金部把闲钱投进一天之内就能变现的「有销路的有价证券」。

examples.en: In the accounts, marketable securities sit apart from long-term investments.
examples.zh: 在账目中，「有销路的有价证券」与长期投资分开列示。

words.enDefinition: a market rate of discount used in professional practice

examples.en: Price the bill by discounting at the market rate of discount for ninety days.
examples.zh: 按90天期的「市场折扣(贴现)率」对票据做贴现定价。

examples.en: When the market rate of discount rises, older bond prices fall.
examples.zh: 「市场折扣(贴现)率」上升时，旧债券的价格就会下跌。

words.enDefinition: a market rate of interest used in professional practice

examples.en: Our deposit account pays the market rate of interest minus a small margin.
examples.zh: 我们的存款账户按「市场利率」减去一点利差来付息。

examples.en: Mortgage offers track the market rate of interest published each Friday.
examples.zh: 房贷报价紧随每周五公布的「市场利率」。

collocations: calculate the market rate of interest
compare the market rate of interest
interpret the market rate of interest

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for investment of sinking

examples.en: The trustee reports quarterly on the investment of sinking fund money.
examples.zh: 受托人每个季度汇报「偿债基金的投资」情况。

examples.en: Conservative rules govern the investment of sinking fund balances until bonds fall due.
examples.zh: 在债券到期之前，「偿债基金的投资」须遵循保守的规则。

collocations: arrange the investment of sinking fund
monitor the investment of sinking fund
repay the investment of sinking fund

words.enDefinition: the complete set of investments held by an investor or fund

examples.en: Her investment portfolio mixes government bonds, dividend stocks, and a little gold.
examples.zh: 她的「投资组合」搭配了国债、分红股票和少量黄金。

examples.en: The manager rebalances the investment portfolio twice a year to keep risks in check.
examples.zh: 基金经理每年两次调整「投资组合」，把风险控制在目标范围内。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to low dividend

examples.en: Growth funds favor low dividend stock because profits are reinvested instead.
examples.zh: 成长型基金偏爱「低股利股票」，因为利润都拿去再投资了。

examples.en: Retirees avoid low dividend stock when they need steady cash each quarter.
examples.zh: 需要每季度稳定现金的退休人士，会避开「低股利股票」。

words.enDefinition: a committed credit arrangement available for more than one year

examples.en: The plant upgrade is funded by a long-term credit facility from the development bank.
examples.zh: 工厂升级改造由开发银行提供的「长期信用贷款」支持。

examples.en: They renegotiated the long-term credit facility to extend repayment over eight years.
examples.zh: 他们重新谈判了「长期信用贷款」，把还款期延长到八年。

words.enDefinition: an increase in value arising from long-term capital

examples.en: Shares held for over a year are taxed as long-term capital gain.
examples.zh: 持股超过一年，出售所得按「长期资本收益(利得)」征税。

examples.en: The land sale produced a long-term capital gain of two hundred thousand.
examples.zh: 出售土地产生了二十万元的「长期资本收益(利得)」。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to investment

examples.en: The bank's investment securities include Treasuries and top-rated corporate bonds.
examples.zh: 这家银行的「投资证券」包括国债和高评级公司债券。

examples.en: Falling rates lifted the value of the fund's investment securities this quarter.
examples.zh: 利率下行，本季度该基金「投资证券」的市值有所上升。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for made-up

examples.en: Jobbers quoted a made-up price for the inactive shares until the market reopened.
examples.zh: 市场重新开市之前，经纪商就这些冷门股报出了「股票交易的场外价格」。

examples.en: We settled the block at a made-up price agreed between the two brokers.
examples.zh: 这批股票按两家经纪商议定的「股票交易的场外价格」成交。

words.enDefinition: a maintenance of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: Company law requires the maintenance of capital before any dividend can be paid.
examples.zh: 依据公司法，分红之前必须先做到「资本保全」。

examples.en: The doctrine of maintenance of capital protects creditors from asset stripping.
examples.zh: 「资本保全」原则保护债权人免遭资产被掏空。

words.enDefinition: a project for major individual investment

examples.en: The bridge is a major individual investment project requiring cabinet approval.
examples.zh: 这座大桥是「主要单项投资项目」，需经内阁批准。

examples.en: Auditors reviewed cash flows for the major individual investment project line by line.
examples.zh: 审计人员逐项核对了「主要单项投资项目」的现金流。

words.enDefinition: a market for investment

examples.en: Cheap money revived the investment market for office towers last autumn.
examples.zh: 去年秋天，低息资金让写字楼「投资市场」重新活跃起来。

examples.en: New rules cooled the investment market for farmland and vineyards.
examples.zh: 新规给农田和葡萄园的「投资市场」降了温。

words.enDefinition: an enterprise engaged in investment in

examples.en: Regional grants revived investment in enterprise after two flat years.
examples.zh: 经过两年的平淡期，区域补贴重新带火了「企业投资」。

examples.en: Her investment in enterprise businesses now spans logistics and cold storage.
examples.zh: 她的「企业投资」如今涵盖物流与冷链仓储。

words.enDefinition: stocks of investment in

examples.en: His investment in stocks grew quietly while everyone chased crypto.
examples.zh: 在人人追捧加密货币的时候，他的「股票投资」悄悄增值。

examples.en: The report separates investment in stocks from bond holdings in the accounts.
examples.zh: 报表把「股票投资」与债券持仓分开列示。

words.enDefinition: an investment in a subsidiary company

examples.en: The parent's investment in subsidiary-company shares is carried at cost.
examples.zh: 母公司账上按成本列示「子公司投资」。

examples.en: They wrote down the investment in subsidiary-company after losses in the overseas unit.
examples.zh: 海外子公司亏损之后，他们对「子公司投资」做了减记。

words.enDefinition: money received from investment

examples.en: Dividends and bond coupons make up most of the endowment's investment income.
examples.zh: 股息和债券利息占基金会「投资收益」的大头。

examples.en: Lower rates cut investment income, so the club raised membership fees.
examples.zh: 利率下降削减了「投资收益」，俱乐部因此上调了会费。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to investment in

examples.en: The council placed an investment in securities with a licensed asset manager.
examples.zh: 委员会把「有价证券投资」交给持牌资产管理机构打理。

examples.en: Their investment in securities must stay within the trustee's approved list.
examples.zh: 他们的「有价证券投资」必须限于受托人核准的清单之内。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from investment

examples.en: Fast fashion chains live on high investment turnover rather than fat margins.
examples.zh: 快时尚连锁靠的是高「投资周转率」，而不是丰厚的利润率。

examples.en: The plant's investment turnover doubled after the automation upgrade last year.
examples.zh: 去年完成自动化改造后，工厂的「投资周转率」翻了一番。

words.enDefinition: a firm that manages or provides investment services

examples.en: She spent last summer interning at an investment firm screening private-credit deals.
examples.zh: 她在一家「投资公司」实习，负责筛选私募信贷交易。

examples.en: The regulator fined the investment firm for overstating fund performance.
examples.zh: 这家「投资公司」因夸大基金业绩而被监管机构罚款。

collocations: open an account at the investment firm

words.enDefinition: products related to investment

examples.en: Machinery orders signal demand for investment goods across the economy.
examples.zh: 机械订单反映出全行业对「投资货物」的需求。

examples.en: Tariffs raised the price of investment goods, delaying factory upgrades.
examples.zh: 关税抬高了「投资货物」的价格，工厂升级被迫推迟。

words.enDefinition: a firm dealing in investment

examples.en: The investment house underwrote the regional airline's return to the market.
examples.zh: 这家「投资公司」包销了区域航空公司的重返市场发行。

examples.en: Old families in the city still bank with the same investment house.
examples.zh: 城里的老牌家族至今仍与同一家「投资公司」保持往来。

words.enDefinition: an investment in a partnership used in professional practice

examples.en: Her investment in a partnership bought her a third of the clinic.
examples.zh: 她通过「对合伙企业的投资」取得了诊所三分之一的份额。

examples.en: Unlike shares, an investment in a partnership carries unlimited liability risks.
examples.zh: 与股份不同，「对合伙企业的投资」在某些辖区要承担无限责任风险。

words.enDefinition: money committed to buying bonds as an investment

examples.en: The insurer's investment in bonds matches its promises to pay future claims.
examples.zh: 保险公司的「债券投资」与其未来的赔付承诺相匹配。

examples.en: Rising yields marked the fund's investment in bonds down this quarter.
examples.zh: 收益率上升，本季度基金的「债券投资」被减记。

words.zhGloss: 被投资企业；投资对象公司
words.enDefinition: a firm in which an investor holds an ownership interest
acceptedZhAnswers: 被投资企业；投资对象公司

examples.en: The fund appoints two directors to each invested firm's board.
examples.zh: 基金向每家「被投资企业」的董事会委派两名董事。

examples.en: Quarterly reports from the invested firm arrive within thirty days of quarter-end.
examples.zh: 「投资对象公司」的季度报告须在季末三十天内送达。

words.enDefinition: the cost of investment

examples.en: Legal fees pushed the investment cost of the wind farm beyond budget.
examples.zh: 法律费用使风电场的「投资费用」超出了预算。

examples.en: The city publishes each project's investment cost before council approval.
examples.zh: 议会在审批之前，市政府会公布每个项目的「投资费用」。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in investment

examples.en: The state-owned investment corporation took a stake in the chip maker.
examples.zh: 这家国有「投资公司」入股了芯片制造商。

examples.en: As an investment corporation, it holds assets but rarely runs operations.
examples.zh: 作为「投资公司」，它持有资产，却很少亲自经营。

words.enDefinition: an institute representing investment companies

examples.en: The investment company institute publishes monthly flows into mutual funds.
examples.zh: 「投资公司协会」每月发布共同基金的资金流向数据。

examples.en: Fund boards follow the investment company institute's guidance on fee disclosure.
examples.zh: 基金董事会参照「投资公司协会」的费用披露指引行事。

collocations: bank with the investment company institute

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with investment

examples.en: The fund is registered as an investment company under federal law.
examples.zh: 该基金依法注册为「投资公司」。

examples.en: Her investment company buys small apartment buildings and rents them out.
examples.zh: 她的「投资公司」收购小型公寓楼并对外出租。

collocations: open an account at the investment company

words.enDefinition: capital associated with investment

examples.en: Family offices provide patient investment capital that startups often need.
examples.zh: 家族办公室能提供初创企业最缺的「投资资本」，且不急于退出。

examples.en: The region lacks investment capital, so good ideas die young.
examples.zh: 该地区缺乏「投资资本」，好点子往往中途夭折。

words.enDefinition: a period of rapidly rising investment activity

examples.en: Cheap energy triggered an investment boom in petrochemical plants along the coast.
examples.zh: 廉价能源引发了沿海石化厂的一轮「投资高涨」。

examples.en: The investment boom of the nineties left the city with empty offices.
examples.zh: 九十年代的「投资高涨」给这座城市留下成片的空置写字楼。

words.enDefinition: a investment bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: Grandma's investment bond pays her a fixed sum every March.
examples.zh: 外婆的「投资债券」每年三月给她一笔固定收益。

examples.en: Money locked in the investment bond for five years earns a bonus rate.
examples.zh: 这笔「投资债券」资金锁定五年，可以享受优惠利率。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with investment

examples.en: The annual report lists investment assets at fair value each December.
examples.zh: 年报按每年十二月的公允价值列示「投资资产」。

examples.en: Insurers classify investment assets by liquidity to meet claim payouts.
examples.zh: 保险公司按流动性对「投资资产」分类，以确保赔款兑付。

words.enDefinition: a bank that advises on capital markets, M&A, and securities issuance

examples.en: The investment bank underwrote the railway company's first euro bond.
examples.zh: 这家「投资银行」包销了铁路公司的首只欧元债券。

examples.en: After graduation he joined an investment bank in the mergers team.
examples.zh: 毕业后他加入一家「投资银行」，进了并购团队。

collocations: open an account at the investment bank

words.enDefinition: a person who works at an investment bank arranging financings and securities issues

examples.en: A seasoned investment banker advised the founders through the listing.
examples.zh: 一位经验丰富的「投资银行家」全程指导创始人完成了上市。

examples.en: The investment banker flew overnight to win the takeover mandate.
examples.zh: 这位「投资银行家」连夜飞过去，只为拿下这单收购委托。

words.enDefinition: banking related to investment

examples.en: Fee income from investment banking kept the quarter profitable despite weak trading.
examples.zh: 尽管交易低迷，来自「投资银行业务」的手续费收入仍让季度实现盈利。

examples.en: She moved from auditing into investment banking, covering utilities deals.
examples.zh: 她从审计转行做「投资银行业务」，负责公用事业类交易。

words.enDefinition: a control of investment used in professional practice

examples.en: The ministry keeps firm control of investment approvals for strategic sectors.
examples.zh: 战略行业的「投资的控制(管理)」审批权仍牢牢掌握在部委手中。

examples.en: The parent lost control of investment decisions after the stake fell below half.
examples.zh: 持股跌破一半之后，母公司失去了「投资的控制(管理)」决策权。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with production

examples.en: Textile families reinvested profits as production capital in new spinning machines.
examples.zh: 纺织世家把利润重新投入新纺机，转化为「生产资本」。

examples.en: Machinery, workshops, and inventory together form the firm's production capital.
examples.zh: 机器、厂房和存货共同构成这家企业的「生产资本」。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from producer's

examples.en: Stricter buyer standards raise the producer's risk of rejecting good batches.
examples.zh: 买方标准收紧，「生产者的风险」随之上升，合格批次也可能被误拒。

examples.en: Statisticians set sampling plans by weighing producer's risk and consumer's risk.
examples.zh: 统计人员权衡「生产者的风险」与消费者的风险，据此制定抽检方案。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with producer

examples.en: The co-op lent producer capital for seeds before the rains.
examples.zh: 雨季来临之前，合作社借出「生产资本」供社员购买种子。

examples.en: Tractors, pumps, and barns together embody the farm's producer capital.
examples.zh: 拖拉机、水泵和谷仓合在一起，就是这座农场的「生产资本」。

words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to prime

examples.en: The bank quotes prime interest only to its most creditworthy corporate clients.
examples.zh: 银行只对最优质的公司客户报出「最低银行利率」。

examples.en: Our credit line floats at prime interest plus one and a half points.
examples.zh: 我们的授信额度按「最低银行利率」加1.5个点浮动计息。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for buffer

examples.en: The commodity board runs a buffer fund to steady coffee prices.
examples.zh: 商品委员会设立「平准基金」来稳定咖啡价格。

examples.en: A buffer fund buys when prices slump and sells when they spike.
examples.zh: 「平准基金」在价格低迷时买入，在价格暴涨时卖出。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by project

examples.en: The tunnel was financed with a project loan repayable from tolls.
examples.zh: 这条隧道以「项目贷款」融资，靠通行费偿还。

examples.en: Banks approved the project loan after reviewing thirty-year traffic forecasts.
examples.zh: 银行审阅了三十年的车流预测后，批准了这笔「项目贷款」。

words.enDefinition: ownership interest related to proprietary

examples.en: In the sole trader's books, proprietary equity equals assets minus liabilities.
examples.zh: 在个体经营者的账上，「业主权益」等于资产减去负债。

examples.en: Drawings by the owner reduce proprietary equity at each year-end.
examples.zh: 业主提款会在每个年末减少「业主权益」。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by production payment

examples.en: The drilling program was funded by a production payment loan secured on future output.
examples.zh: 钻井计划由以未来产量作押的「产品支付贷款」提供资金。

examples.en: The bank recovered the production payment loan from the first year's oil sales.
examples.zh: 银行用第一年的石油销售收入收回了「产品支付贷款」。

words.enDefinition: the party holding a production payment interest and receiving its fixed share of output

examples.en: As production payment owner, the fund receives a fixed share of each barrel.
examples.zh: 作为「产品支付权益所有人」，该基金从每桶石油中获得固定分成。

examples.en: The production payment owner has no claim on operating costs or mine decisions.
examples.zh: 「产品支付权益所有人」对运营成本和矿山决策没有发言权。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with productive

examples.en: Honest taxes fund roads that turn savings into productive capital.
examples.zh: 诚信征收的税收修成道路，把储蓄变成了「生产资本」。

examples.en: Idle land is wealth withheld from productive capital and from workers' wages.
examples.zh: 闲置土地是游离于「生产资本」和劳动者工资之外的财富。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from productive

examples.en: Railways were the era's most prized form of productive investment.
examples.zh: 铁路是那个时代最受追捧的「生产性投资」。

examples.en: Only productive investment creates jobs; speculation merely moves existing assets around.
examples.zh: 只有「生产性投资」才创造就业，投机只是在搬运存量资产。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to profit

examples.en: After the fire, profit insurance covered the months of lost earnings.
examples.zh: 火灾过后，「利润保险」赔付了此后数月的收入损失。

examples.en: The factory's profit insurance is pegged to last year's margin.
examples.zh: 工厂的「利润保险」以去年的利润率为基准。

words.enDefinition: a profit available for dividend used in professional practice

examples.en: Only profit available for dividend after the legal reserve may be distributed.
examples.zh: 提足法定准备金后，「可供分配股利的利润」才能向股东分配。

examples.en: The company reports profit available for dividend of two million this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年公布的「可供分配股利的利润」为两百万元。

words.enDefinition: profit obtained from redemption

examples.en: Buying below par produced a profit from redemption when the bonds matured.
examples.zh: 折价买入的债券到期按面值兑付，实现了「由赎还(债券)获得利润」。

examples.en: Accountants spread the profit from redemption over the bond's remaining life.
examples.zh: 会计把「由赎还(债券)获得利润」在债券剩余期限内摊销。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to profit sharing

examples.en: Profit sharing securities pay extra coupons when the company beats its profit target.
examples.zh: 公司利润超过目标时，「利润分享有价证券」会加付利息。

examples.en: Employees bought profit sharing securities instead of asking for wage rises.
examples.zh: 员工购入「利润分享有价证券」，以此代替加薪的诉求。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by hard

examples.en: The ministry accepted a hard loan because grant money had dried up.
examples.zh: 赠款枯竭，该部委只能接受「条件苛刻的贷款」。

examples.en: A hard loan must be repaid in dollars, whatever the local currency does.
examples.zh: 「条件苛刻的贷款」必须以美元偿还，不论本币如何波动。

words.enDefinition: official rules governing currency

examples.en: Stricter currency regulations cap how much cash travelers may carry abroad.
examples.zh: 更严格的「外汇管理条例」限制了旅客可携带出境的现金额度。

examples.en: The subsidiary repatriates dividends slowly because of local currency regulations.
examples.zh: 受当地「外汇管理条例」约束，子公司分红汇回的速度很慢。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from current

examples.en: The bond sleeve is a current investment, earmarked for next year's payouts.
examples.zh: 这批债券属于「流动投资」，专门用于明年的支出安排。

examples.en: Current investment in T-bills keeps the charity ready for urgent relief work.
examples.zh: 投资于国库券的「流动投资」，让慈善机构随时能应对紧急救援。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from businessman's

examples.en: She shrugs off bad debts as the ordinary businessman's risk.
examples.zh: 她把坏账视为「商人的风险」，一笑置之。

examples.en: Shipping delays add to the businessman's risk every monsoon season.
examples.zh: 每逢季风季，「商人的风险」又多了一项发货延误。

words.enDefinition: having a high level of capital relative to activity

examples.en: Insured against shocks and highly capitalised, the bank sailed through the crisis.
examples.zh: 这家银行抗冲击能力强、「资本充足」，安然度过了危机。

examples.en: Regulators treat highly capitalised lenders as safe harbors in a storm.
examples.zh: 监管者将「资本充足」的放贷机构视为风暴中的安全港。

words.enDefinition: stock (equity or inventory) related to high priced

examples.en: Berkshire-style shares show how high priced stock can still find buyers.
examples.zh: 伯克希尔式的股票说明，「高价股」照样有人追捧。

examples.en: She avoids high priced stock because one bad quarter moves the needle fast.
examples.zh: 她回避「高价股」，因为一个糟糕的季度就能让波动迅速放大。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to high grade

examples.en: Trustees stick to high grade stock with decades of steady dividends.
examples.zh: 受托人只持有分红稳健数十年的「高级股票」。

examples.en: The crash spared most high grade stock but wiped out the speculators.
examples.zh: 崩盘未伤及多数「高级股票」，投机者却血本无归。

words.enDefinition: a policy proof of interest used in professional practice

examples.en: The bank demanded a policy proof of interest before releasing the cargo papers.
examples.zh: 银行要求先出示「保险单证明权益」，然后才放行提货单据。

examples.en: His policy proof of interest established insurable ownership of the timber shipment.
examples.zh: 他的「保险单证明权益」证明了这批木材的可保所有权。

collocations: calculate the policy proof of interest
compare the policy proof of interest
interpret the policy proof of interest

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by political risk

examples.en: The agency insured the political risk loan against expropriation and war.
examples.zh: 该机构为「政治风险贷款」提供征收和战争风险的保障。

examples.en: Lenders priced the political risk loan wide after the coup.
examples.zh: 政变之后，放贷方对「政治风险贷款」的要价大幅上调。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the cumulative income type

examples.en: Cumulative income bonds roll unpaid coupons forward until earnings recover.
examples.zh: 「累积收益债券」会把未付的利息滚存，直到盈利恢复为止。

examples.en: In the slump year, no coupon was paid on the cumulative income bonds.
examples.zh: 萧条的那一年，「累积收益债券」的利息分文未付。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with positive

examples.en: Auditors verified positive capital at year-end, easing the regulator's concerns.
examples.zh: 审计确认年末「确实资本」为正，监管部门的担忧有所缓解。

examples.en: A firm with positive capital can absorb surprises without breaching covenants.
examples.zh: 拥有「确实资本」的公司，能够承受意外冲击而不触发违约条款。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to port risk

examples.en: While berthed in Mombasa, the vessel stayed covered by port risk insurance.
examples.zh: 船舶停靠蒙巴萨期间，仍享有「港内危险保险」的保障。

examples.en: Port risk insurance excludes fires caused by the crew's negligence.
examples.zh: 「港内危险保险」不承保因船员疏忽引发的火灾。

words.enDefinition: the risk-reducing effect of combining assets in a portfolio

examples.en: Blending bonds with stocks gives the portfolio its famous portfolio effect.
examples.zh: 债券与股票搭配，让组合享有了著名的「投资组合效应」。

examples.en: The portfolio effect means one bad holding rarely sinks a diversified fund.
examples.zh: 「投资组合效应」意味着单一持仓出问题，很少能拖垮分散化的基金。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from portfolio foreign

examples.en: Much portfolio foreign investment flows into dollar bonds whenever home markets wobble.
examples.zh: 本土市场一旦动荡，大量「国外有价证券投资」便会流向美元债券。

examples.en: Unlike building factories abroad, portfolio foreign investment can exit overnight.
examples.zh: 与在海外建厂不同，「国外有价证券投资」可以一夜之间撤出。

words.enDefinition: work performed related to portfolio management

examples.en: The bank's portfolio management service rebalances our holdings twice a year.
examples.zh: 银行的「投资组合管理服务」每年为我们的持仓做两次再平衡。

examples.en: She pays a modest fee for the portfolio management service and its reports.
examples.zh: 她为「投资组合管理服务」及其配套报告支付适度的费用。

words.enDefinition: a market for curb

examples.en: Shares of the failed issuer still trade in the curb market.
examples.zh: 那家破产发行人的股票仍在「场外证券市场」交易。

examples.en: Regulators watch the curb market for signs of manipulative trading.
examples.zh: 监管者紧盯「场外证券市场」，防范操纵交易的迹象。

words.enDefinition: a retail-oriented bank serving the general public

examples.en: The popular bank on the square serves market traders and students alike.
examples.zh: 广场上的这家「大众银行」既服务市场商贩，也服务学生。

examples.en: A popular bank keeps opening fees near zero to win everyday savers.
examples.zh: 「大众银行」把开户费用压到近乎为零，争夺日常储户。

words.enDefinition: a price concerning money

examples.en: When central banks tighten, the price of money rises for everyone.
examples.zh: 央行收紧政策时，「贷款利率」随之上升，人人都感受到资金变贵了。

examples.en: Cheap oil and a low price of money fueled the building boom.
examples.zh: 廉价石油加上低「贷款利率」，助推了那一轮建房热潮。

words.enDefinition: studies of pre-investment

examples.en: The lender released funds only after two years of pre-investment studies.
examples.zh: 经过两年的「投资前研究」，放贷方才发放资金。

examples.en: Thorough pre-investment studies exposed the port project's unrealistic cargo forecasts.
examples.zh: 周密的「投资前研究」揭露了港口项目不切实际的货量预测。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning business

examples.en: The supplier extended business credit of sixty days to the restaurant.
examples.zh: 供应商给这家餐馆提供了六十天的「商业信贷」。

examples.en: Tight business credit forced the workshop to delay buying new lathes.
examples.zh: 「商业信贷」收紧，车间不得不推迟购买新车床。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by premium

examples.en: The agent advanced a premium loan so the client's cover would not lapse.
examples.zh: 代理人垫了一笔「保险费借款」，以免客户的保障失效。

examples.en: Interest on the premium loan accrues against the policy's cash value.
examples.zh: 「保险费借款」的利息会冲减保单的现金价值。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the premium on type

examples.en: Falling rates left a premium on bonds issued back in January.
examples.zh: 利率下行，一月间发行的债券出现了「债券(公司债)溢价」。

examples.en: The premium on bonds amortizes down to par by the maturity date.
examples.zh: 「债券(公司债)溢价」会逐步摊销，到期时回归面值。

words.enDefinition: a payment of an insurance premium

examples.en: Set up a direct debit so the premium payment never lapses.
examples.zh: 设置自动扣款，「保险费支付」就不会中断。

examples.en: The premium payment for the fleet policy is due each January.
examples.zh: 车队保单的「保险费支付」每年一月到期。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by business

examples.en: The credit union approved a business loan to expand the bike shop.
examples.zh: 信用合作社批准了一笔「商业贷款」，用于扩大自行车店的规模。

examples.en: Their business loan application failed because the accounts showed no profit.
examples.zh: 由于账面没有利润，他们的「商业贷款」申请被拒。

words.enDefinition: a date of payment used in professional practice

examples.en: The invoice lists the date of payment as the fifteenth of next month.
examples.zh: 发票上的「付款日期」是下月十五日。

examples.en: The dividend's date of payment falls three weeks after the record date.
examples.zh: 股利的「付款日期」定在股权登记日之后三周。

words.enDefinition: a reacquired bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The treasury holds every reacquired bond until market conditions improve.
examples.zh: 资金部把每一只「重获债券」持有到市况好转再作处置。

examples.en: Interest stops accruing on a reacquired bond the day the company buys it back.
examples.zh: 公司回购的当天，「重获债券」即停止计息。

words.enDefinition: bonds that have been authorised for issue

examples.en: The charter lists bonds authorized at fifty million for the water works.
examples.zh: 章程载明「额定债券」为五千万元，用于供水工程。

examples.en: Only bonds authorized in the prospectus may actually be issued.
examples.zh: 只有招股书中「额定债券」范围内的债券才能实际发行。

words.enDefinition: bonds that has been issued

examples.en: The report shows bonds issued this spring carrying a three percent coupon.
examples.zh: 报告显示，今年春天「已发行债券」的票息为3%。

examples.en: Bonds issued at par keep the accounting simple for the finance team.
examples.zh: 按面值发行的「已发行债券」，让财务团队记账省心。

words.enDefinition: averages of bond

examples.en: Rising bond averages confirmed the flight from equities this week.
examples.zh: 「债券平均价格」走高，印证了本周资金撤离股市。

examples.en: The morning sheet prints bond averages for each maturity band.
examples.zh: 早间行情表按期限段列出「债券平均价格」。

words.enDefinition: coupons attached to bonds for interest collection

examples.en: He clips the bond coupons twice a year, like his father did.
examples.zh: 他像父亲当年那样，一年两次剪下「债券息票」去兑息。

examples.en: Missing bond coupons void the claim to that period's interest.
examples.zh: 「债券息票」缺失，对应期间的利息请求即告无效。

words.enDefinition: bond interest that has been received

examples.en: The fund's bond interest received reached a record this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度基金的「债券利息收入」创下新高。

examples.en: Cash flow from bond interest received arrives on the fifth of each month.
examples.zh: 「债券利息收入」的现金流每月五日到账。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with reduction of legal

examples.en: Courts scrutinize any reduction of legal capital for creditor protection.
examples.zh: 法院会对「法定资本的缩减」从严审查，以保护债权人。

examples.en: The reduction of legal capital required newspaper notices and creditor consent.
examples.zh: 「法定资本的缩减」需要刊登公告并取得债权人同意。

collocations: calculate the reduction of legal capital
compare the reduction of legal capital
reduce the reduction of legal capital

words.enDefinition: a reduction of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: Shareholders approved the reduction of capital to wipe out accumulated losses.
examples.zh: 股东们批准「资本的减少」，以冲销累计亏损。

examples.en: A reduction of capital returned surplus cash to the owners.
examples.zh: 这次「资本的减少」把多余的现金返还给了股东。

words.enDefinition: the process of estimating the worth of bond

examples.en: The bond valuation assumes rates stay flat through the holding period.
examples.zh: 这份「债券估价」假设持有期内利率保持不变。

examples.en: Students ran a bond valuation exercise with different yield curves.
examples.zh: 学生们用不同的收益率曲线做了「债券估价」练习。

words.enDefinition: a market for bond

examples.en: Record issuance crowded the bond market ahead of the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期之前，创纪录的发行让「债券市场」十分拥挤。

examples.en: She moved from equities to the bond market for steadier returns.
examples.zh: 她从股市转向「债券市场」，寻求更平稳的收益。

collocations: clear goods through the bond market

words.enDefinition: power over bond

examples.en: With a bond power, the broker can transfer registered bonds without the owner present.
examples.zh: 凭一份「债券全权代理证书」，经纪商可在持有人不在场时办理债券转让。

examples.en: Attach the bond power when you lodge the certificates for transfer.
examples.zh: 办理债券过户登记时，请随附「债券全权代理证书」。

words.enDefinition: an extra amount paid for bond

examples.en: We paid a bond premium of four points over par for the utility issue.
examples.zh: 我们以高出面值4个点的「债券溢价」，买入了这只公用事业债券。

examples.en: The bond premium shrinks each year as the maturity date approaches.
examples.zh: 随着到期日临近，「债券溢价」逐年缩小。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside for bond

examples.en: The board voted to build the bond reserve to eight million.
examples.zh: 董事会表决把「债券准备」提高到八百万元。

examples.en: Regulators questioned whether the bond reserve is adequate for the 2030 maturities.
examples.zh: 监管部门质疑，「债券准备」能否覆盖2030年到期的那批债券。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside for bond retirement

examples.en: Each quarter the utility adds cash to its bond retirement reserve.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司每个季度向「债券偿还准备」注入现金。

examples.en: The bond retirement reserve will absorb the notes maturing next March.
examples.zh: 「债券偿还准备」将用于承接明年三月到期的票据。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from government

examples.en: Lenders price government risk into long projects in unstable regions.
examples.zh: 在局势不稳的地区，放贷方会把「政治风险」计入长期项目的定价。

examples.en: Nationalization remains the sharpest form of government risk for foreign miners.
examples.zh: 对外国矿商而言，国有化是「政治风险」最尖锐的形态。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for recourse

examples.en: The agency set up a recourse fund to honor guarantees when members default.
examples.zh: 该机构设立「偿还基金」，在会员违约时代为履行担保。

examples.en: Contributions to the recourse fund come from every member bank.
examples.zh: 「偿还基金」的资金来自每一家会员银行。

words.enDefinition: credit extended to finance public investment projects

examples.en: The development bank extended public investment credit to the irrigation scheme.
examples.zh: 开发银行为灌溉工程提供了「公共投资信贷」。

examples.en: Interest on public investment credit is subsidized for rural projects.
examples.zh: 农村项目的「公共投资信贷」利息可以享受补贴。

words.enDefinition: expenditure on budget for capital

examples.en: The council tripled its budget for capital expenditure on flood defenses.
examples.zh: 议会把防洪工程的「资本支出预算」提高了两倍。

examples.en: Any transfer from the budget for capital expenditure needs full board approval.
examples.zh: 从「资本支出预算」中调剂资金，须经董事会全体批准。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by budget deficit

examples.en: The city closed its budget deficit loan from the state within two years.
examples.zh: 该市在两年内就还清了向州里借的「预算赤字贷款」。

examples.en: Voters rejected another budget deficit loan and demanded spending cuts.
examples.zh: 选民否决了再次举借「预算赤字贷款」，要求削减开支。

words.enDefinition: the cost of prudent investment

examples.en: Fiduciary rules limit the prudent investment cost that advisors may charge.
examples.zh: 信义规则限制了顾问可收取的「审慎投资成本」。

examples.en: Trustees documented each prudent investment cost in the annual accounts.
examples.zh: 受托人在年报中逐项列明了「审慎投资成本」。

words.zhGloss: 以外国货币为单位的汇率报价
words.enDefinition: a quotation in foreign currency used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 以外国货币为单位的汇率报价

examples.en: The dealer gave a quotation in foreign currency for the euro tranche.
examples.zh: 交易员就欧元部分给出了「以外国货币为单位的汇率报价」。

examples.en: Contracts below a million settle at the quotation in foreign currency posted at noon.
examples.zh: 百万元以下的合同按午间发布的「以外国货币为单位的汇率报价」结算。

words.enDefinition: a market for queasy stock

examples.en: The queasy stock market stumbled again on the inflation surprise.
examples.zh: 通胀数据爆冷，本已「不稳定的股票市场」再度跌撞。

examples.en: Advisors warn clients against borrowing into a queasy stock market.
examples.zh: 顾问提醒客户，切勿在「不稳定的股票市场」加杠杆入市。

words.enDefinition: banking related to group

examples.en: Group banking lets the family's six lenders share one treasury desk.
examples.zh: 「集团经营银行业务」让家族旗下的六家银行共用一个资金部。

examples.en: Regulators reviewed the group banking model after two affiliates collapsed together.
examples.zh: 两家关联银行接连倒闭后，监管机构重新审视了「集团经营银行业务」模式。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from gross

examples.en: Gross investment in factories reached a fifteen-year high last quarter.
examples.zh: 上季度工厂领域的「总投资」创下十五年来的新高。

examples.en: Depreciation eats a fifth of gross investment, leaving net additions modest.
examples.zh: 折旧吃掉「总投资」的五分之一，净增额因而有限。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with raise

examples.en: The founders flew to Singapore to raise capital for the battery startup.
examples.zh: 创始人飞赴新加坡，为电池初创公司「筹集资本」。

examples.en: Wind farms raise capital through green bonds and development bank loans.
examples.zh: 风电场通过绿色债券和开发银行贷款来「筹集资本」。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to guarantee

examples.en: The parent railway underwrites every dividend on the guarantee stock.
examples.zh: 母公司铁路为「保证股票」的股利提供全额担保。

examples.en: Investors accepted a lower yield on the guarantee stock for that backing.
examples.zh: 有这层担保，投资者接受了「保证股票」较低的收益率。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the bridge type

examples.en: The county sold bridge bonds to fund the crossing over the gorge.
examples.zh: 该县发行「桥梁债券」，为跨越峡谷的大桥筹资。

examples.en: Tolls on the crossing service the bridge bonds over thirty years.
examples.zh: 大桥的通行费将在三十年内偿付「桥梁债券」。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to quarter

examples.en: Quarter stock of the railway carries a twenty-five dollar par value.
examples.zh: 铁路公司发行的「每股票面25元的股票」，面值即25美元。

examples.en: Small savers preferred quarter stock because single shares stayed affordable.
examples.zh: 小储户偏爱「每股票面25元的股票」，因为单股价格不高。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to quarterly

examples.en: The board raised the quarterly dividend from eighteen to twenty cents.
examples.zh: 董事会把「季度支付的股利」从18美分提高到20美分。

examples.en: Her quarterly dividend checks arrive within a week of the payment date.
examples.zh: 「季度支付的股利」支票在派息日后一周内到账。

words.enDefinition: having more capital than the business can use productively

examples.en: The shipping line is over capitalised, idling ships it cannot profitably run.
examples.zh: 这家航运公司「资本过剩」，把无法盈利运营的船舶闲置了起来。

examples.en: An over capitalised firm earns too little on each dollar of equity.
examples.zh: 「资本过剩」的公司，每一元股本赚到的回报太少。

words.enDefinition: borrowing that exceeds a prudent level relative to capital
